name: hlthstack
description: Teaches Codex and ChatGPT about hlthstack and its health-benefits API: what members get, embed vs API, onboarding, member communications, and endpoints, auth, booking flows, webhooks and common pitfalls.

interface.shortDescription: Explore hlthstack and integrate its health-benefits API
interface.longDescription: Answers questions about hlthstack in plain words for business teams (what members can get, embedding the member app vs building on the API, onboarding, member communications, white-labelling) and helps developers write and debug code against the hlthstack partner API: authentication, health checkup and lab test bookings, doctor consultations, ePharmacy orders, benefit wallets, member pre-registration and webhook verification. It reads the bundled guides and OpenAPI spec instead of guessing, uses staging by default and asks before creating or cancelling anything.
defaultPrompt: Use hlthstack-api to explain what hlthstack can offer our members and how we could integrate it.
Use hlthstack-api to write a function that books a health checkup on staging.
Use hlthstack-api to add a webhook handler that verifies the hlthstack Signature header.
